title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This involves creating the first loop with four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0252, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.0252, 0.0) and ends at (0.0252, 0.0056); the third line starts at (0.0252, 0.0056) and ends at (0.0, 0.0056); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0056) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a sketch scale factor of 0.0252 to ensure the dimensions are accurate. Transform this scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the part by creating a new solid body. The resulting rectangular prism has a length of 0.0251865671641791 units, a width of 0.005597014925373134 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
from cadquery import Workplane, Vector

# Define the sketch
sketch = (
    Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0252, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0252, 0.0056)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0056)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is now stored in 'r'
